messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick heads-up — Orchard Labs renewal in ~45 days. Noticed a ~60% drop in API usage over the last 30d. New procurement contact started 2w ago. Suspect competitive eval.
Tom (Solutions): I pulled the product dashboard — same signal. Their error rate is flat, so not an adoption bug. They kicked off a pilot with LexiAI last Wed (per a forwarded email).
Ben (AE): I talked to their champion last Friday. They asked for a side-by-side cost + 95th percentile latency comparison. I sent our numbers but haven’t heard back. They flagged a pricing sensitivity for batch embedding jobs.
Aisha (CSM): @Ben can you paste the convo notes here? I want to set a short QBR and loop in enablement for the new PM. Also need to confirm whether they tried our batching suggestions.
Ben (AE): Notes pasted below:
```
- Champion: Maya (Data PM)
- Concern: Cost of nightly batch embeddings vs competitor discount
- Request: 95th p99 latency at 5k tokens + estimated monthly token bill for current batch window
- Asks: Can we offer a short-term pricing guardrail or dedicated burst credits?
```
Tom (Solutions): Re: p95 numbers — from the infra team: 95th latency on their typical batch (avg sequence 1.8k tokens) is ~420ms on our ded pool, p99 ~720ms. I can share a one-page comparison w/ quantization options.
Aisha (CSM): Good. Two ask items: (1) Ben — re-open the thread with Maya and schedule 30m QBR this week, prioritize cost/throughput tradeoffs; (2) Tom — can you produce the one-pager with cost delta for 3 quantization profiles + recommended autoscale for nightly window.
Ben (AE): Scheduling now. Tentative QBR Thu 10am PT, sending calendar invite to Maya + procurement.
ops-bot: Note — account health alert created: ORCH-LABS-169847; severity=medium; assigned=Aisha (CSM).
Aisha (CSM): FYI, also adding a small play: offer a 6-week dedicated-burst credit to match competitor pilot throughput for one ingest pipeline, measure cost and latency delta. If they accept, we can convert into a renewal upside talk.
Tom (Solutions): I’ll include a sample config for a burst profile and expected cost calc. Will add a nudge about prefix/KV caching to reduce token costs for repeated queries.
Ben (AE): Sent invite, Maya accepted. Proc contact cc'd. I'll share the convo excerpt and our pricing model doc in the invite.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks. After QBR, let's reconvene in this thread with the outcome and a recommended renewal play (rescue discount vs tech win). If they go with competitor, we should gather their evaluation criteria to feed into product + pricing. :pray:
Tom (Solutions): Agreed. One more note — ask them if the LexiAI pilot requires model export or is solely hosted API; if they need export, we might not be able to match without Private offering.
Ben (AE): Copy. Will confirm during QBR.
Aisha (CSM): Perfect. I'll prep a quick customer health slide and send enablement notes to the onboarding playbook owner.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled in 48h for follow-up: ORCH-LABS-169847
Aisha (CSM): tagging this as renewal-risk: moderate -> needs proactive outreach.
Tom (Solutions): 👍
Ben (AE): 👍
